# [CS025] gRPC Connection Without Transport Security (grpc-insecure-credentials)

A gRPC client dials a remote target with insecure credentials.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Severity** | HIGH |
| **Category** | Security |
| **CWE** | [CWE-319](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/319.html) |
| **OWASP** | A04:2025 |
| **Auto-Fix supported** | No |

## Why It Matters in Go

insecure.NewCredentials() and grpc.WithInsecure() send requests, metadata and tokens in clear text. Loopback, bufnet and Unix socket targets are not reported.

## Vulnerable / Problematic Example

```go
conn, err := grpc.NewClient("payments.internal:443", grpc.WithTransportCredentials(insecure.NewCredentials()))
```

## Safe / Idiomatic Go Pattern

```go
creds := credentials.NewTLS(&tls.Config{MinVersion: tls.VersionTLS12})
conn, err := grpc.NewClient("payments.internal:443", grpc.WithTransportCredentials(creds))
```

## Configuration & Suppression

Disable the rule for the whole module in `.codexsentinel.yaml`:

```yaml
rules:
  disabled: [grpc-insecure-credentials]
```

Change its severity:

```yaml
rules:
  severity_overrides:
    grpc-insecure-credentials: low
```

Suppress one reviewed finding on its line, with the reason:

```go
//codex:ignore grpc-insecure-credentials -- <reason>
```

Or ignore it under a path in `.codexsentinel.ignore`:

```text
internal/legacy/** grpc-insecure-credentials
```
